text: Start in-house labs right in the visit, so every result lands on the chart and none gets lost.
Biscuit is here today because he keeps shaking his head. This is his SOAP.
If a pet has an alert, it shows up top, with who wrote it. Give it a glance before you start.
His ear needs a cytology. In Checkout, add the charge.
Pick Ear cytology.
The line says Not run. The lab is ordered, but nobody has done it yet.
Click the arrow to open the result.
Write what you saw under the microscope.
Not done yet? Save, finish later keeps what you have.
You don't have to finish the lab to keep going. Checkout still works, so the family can pay and you can head out.
Finish the result back at the office, or in the car while a 4Dx runs.
Unfinished labs wait in Labs,
under In-house labs.
Waiting to run lists every in-house lab that's ordered but not done, for the whole practice. Here's Biscuit's, and a skin cytology for Maple from yesterday.
Open one,
finish the notes,
and click Save results.
It moves to Recently resulted.
And it's on Biscuit's chart. Click Chart.
By date shows today's lab in line with the rest of his record.
Click View results to open it,
then View to read the notes.
The Labs tab lists only his labs.
And History shows who entered the result, who finished it, and when.
For techs: you can enter and finish in-house results yourself. No license is needed.
The mistake to avoid: leaving a lab on Save, finish later and forgetting it. Check Waiting to run before your day ends. Start labs in the visit, and finish every one you start.
